text: Digital Logic Circuits Dr. Raahat Devender Singh CSED, TIET Homework from Previous Lecture What is the difference between Computer Organization, Computer Design, and Computer Architecture? 2 Computer Architecture is concerned with the structure and behavior of the computer from the user’s point of view. It is the external view of the computer that anyone who is likely to program a computer should understand. Computer Organization is concerned with the way that hardware components operate and the way they are connected to form the computer. It is the internal view of the computer and the roles various internal components play during program execution.
